summary: Arm A passed stage 1 on the teacher's labels; on navtest it is NOT PROVEN (-0.20 [-1.30, +0.92] PDMS vs the deployed system on 923 confirmation tokens), so it is not adopted. The held-out gain did not transfer: selection optimised against the teacher's labels does not improve selection against PDMS. Next: SFT-4 on the paper's PDM targets.
